tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind everything (`bg-canvas` on body and the shell). Cards and panels sit on it in `surface`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, inputs, the sticky page header (at 80% with blur) and the sidebar (at 60%). Default ground for body text.

tokens.name: surface-secondary
tokens.usage: Hover fill for secondary/ghost buttons and nav items, table headers, code blocks, modal footers (at 40%), disabled inputs.

tokens.name: surface-tertiary
tokens.usage: Neutral chips and wells: neutral Badge, CountPill, the SegmentedControl track (at 70%), inline code, skeleton shimmer.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised layers: modals, drawers, toasts and task cards on the board. Same as surface in light; a step lighter in dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline for cards, inputs, headers and dividers. Decorative only: 1.27:1 on surface, so it is never the sole cue for a control (inputs also carry shadow-xs and a hover change).

tokens.name: border-light
tokens.usage: Quieter internal dividers: the PageHeader toolbar row, the modal footer rule.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border for controls and secondary buttons, unchecked Checkbox outline, Toggle off track, scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on canvas, every surface and surface-elevated (14:1 or better in both themes). Also the Tooltip fill, with surface as its text.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, secondary labels, ghost-button labels, blockquotes. 6.4:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, timestamps, placeholders, eyebrows, idle icons. Reads 4.8:1 on surface and surface-elevated in both themes; the source also sets it on canvas, surface-secondary and surface-tertiary where it falls to 3.95-4.48:1 (kept as in the source; prefer text-secondary there for body-size copy).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand indigo, the solid shade: fills and borders (`bg-primary`, `border-primary/50`, tints `bg-primary/10`). Primary buttons, the active nav indicator, selected states, focus rings (`ring-primary/60`), the Toggle on track, checkbox fill.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a solid primary control (`hover:bg-primary-hover`).

tokens.name: primary-fg
tokens.usage: Label and icons on a solid primary fill (primary Button, checked Checkbox). 6.3:1 in light; 4.47:1 in dark and 3.58:1 on the dark hover shade (source values, kept).

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Readable indigo for text: links, the active nav label, `text-primary`. 5.2:1 or better on every surface in light, 7:1+ in dark; 5.4:1 on the primary/10 tint. Tailwind maps `text-primary` to this shade, not to the solid one.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive red, the solid shade: fills and borders (`bg-danger`, `border-danger/50`, tints `bg-danger/10`). Danger buttons, errors, the required asterisk, "changes requested" and "canceled" statuses, priority P3.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a solid danger control (`hover:bg-danger-hover`).

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Label on a solid danger fill (danger Button). 4.83:1 in both themes; 3.76:1 on the dark hover shade (kept).

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error text, danger-ghost labels, danger badges (`text-danger`). 5.3:1+ on every surface in both themes. Tailwind maps `text-danger` to this shade, not to the solid one.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive green, the solid shade: fills and borders (`bg-success`, `border-success/50`, tints `bg-success/10`). Approved, merged, complete and succeeded statuses; the CopyButton check; the OpenCode runner.

tokens.name: success-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a solid success control (`hover:bg-success-hover`).

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Text on a solid success fill. White in light is only 3.3:1 (large text only; kept from the source); dark uses deep green at 6.5:1.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success text and badges (`text-success`). 5.0:1 on surface in light (4.1-4.65:1 on canvas and the grey surfaces), 8.9:1+ in dark; 4.5:1 on its /10 tint in light. Tailwind maps `text-success` to this shade, not to the solid one.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention amber, the solid shade: fills and borders (`bg-warning`, `border-warning/50`, tints `bg-warning/10`). Review states (plan review, code review, reviewing, merging), priority P2, reverted jobs, risky-setting hints; the Gemini runner.

tokens.name: warning-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a solid warning control (`hover:bg-warning-hover`).

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Text on a solid warning fill. White in light is only 3.19:1 (large text only; kept from the source); dark uses deep brown at 7:1.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text and badges (`text-warning`). 5.0:1 on surface in light (4.15-4.65:1 on canvas and the grey surfaces), 9:1+ in dark; 4.5:1 on its /10 tint in light. Tailwind maps `text-warning` to this shade, not to the solid one.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational blue, the solid shade: fills and borders (`bg-info`, `border-info/50`, tints `bg-info/10`). Ready-for-code and coding statuses, running jobs, priority P1, info alerts; the Codex runner.

tokens.name: info-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a solid info control (`hover:bg-info-hover`).

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Text on a solid info fill. 5.17:1 in light; 3.68:1 in dark and 2.54:1 on the dark hover (kept from the source; large text only there).

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Info text and badges (`text-info`). 5.5:1+ on every surface in light, 6:1+ in dark. Tailwind maps `text-info` to this shade, not to the solid one.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Violet, the solid shade: fills and borders (`bg-accent`, `border-accent/50`, tints `bg-accent/10`). Planning status and plan messages, the Claude runner, the second stop of the brand gradient.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a solid accent control (`hover:bg-accent-hover`).

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text on a solid accent fill. 5.7:1 in light; 4.23:1 in dark and 2.72:1 on the dark hover (kept from the source).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent text and badges (`text-accent`). 5.7:1+ on every surface in both themes. Tailwind maps `text-accent` to this shade, not to the solid one.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and drawers, with a 2-3px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: hl-keyword
tokens.usage: Syntax highlighting (highlight.js in Markdown code blocks, on surface-secondary). Keywords, types, template tags.

tokens.name: hl-string
tokens.usage: Syntax highlighting (highlight.js in Markdown code blocks, on surface-secondary). Strings and regexes.

tokens.name: hl-number
tokens.usage: Syntax highlighting (highlight.js in Markdown code blocks, on surface-secondary). Numbers, literals, attributes, operators, section headings.

tokens.name: hl-title
tokens.usage: Syntax highlighting (highlight.js in Markdown code blocks, on surface-secondary). Function and class names.

tokens.name: hl-attr
tokens.usage: Syntax highlighting (highlight.js in Markdown code blocks, on surface-secondary). Attribute names (same value as hl-number).

tokens.name: hl-comment
tokens.usage: Syntax highlighting (highlight.js in Markdown code blocks, on surface-secondary). Comments, set in italic.

tokens.name: hl-meta
tokens.usage: Syntax highlighting (highlight.js in Markdown code blocks, on surface-secondary). Tag names, selectors, quotes.

tokens.name: hl-variable
tokens.usage: Syntax highlighting (highlight.js in Markdown code blocks, on surface-secondary). Built-ins, symbols, list bullets.

families.sans: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The value in a runner stat tile (`text-lg font-semibold leading-tight tabular-nums`), under an eyebrow label. The largest UI text.

styles.name: brand-name
styles.usage: The product name in the sidebar (`text-[15px] font-bold tracking-tight`).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: PageHeader h1 (`text-[17px] font-semibold tracking-tight`), in text.

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.usage: Modal title and the full-size EmptyState title (`text-base font-semibold`).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Describe the work; an agent picks it up from the queue.
styles.usage: Default UI copy (`text-sm`); card titles, md/lg buttons and nav items at 500.

styles.name: markdown
styles.sample: Plans, reviews and agent notes render as Markdown.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field and Toggle labels, md SegmentedControl, Alert body, sm inputs (`text-[13px]`); page descriptions at 400 in text-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Jobs appear here as soon as the runner claims a task.
styles.usage: Hints, field errors, timestamps (`text-xs`); sm buttons, tooltips and md badges at 500.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-label above a group or value (`.eyebrow`), in text-muted. Always uppercase.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Small Badge and StatusBadge text (`text-[11px] leading-none`); tab counts and CountPill at 600 with tabular numbers.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Branch names, paths, ids and commands in the UI (`font-mono text-xs`).

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code in Markdown, on surface-tertiary with a border hairline.

spacing.note: Tailwind's default 4px scale; names follow the utility keys (`p-4`, `gap-2.5`). These are the steps the portal uses.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets: SegmentedControl padding and thumb inset, the gap between nav items.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-1.5

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-2.5

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Task card padding, nav item x-padding, sidebar padding, the gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: md button x-padding, the modal header icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: lg button x-padding, drawer header x-padding, the gap between nav groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter (`px-6` in PageHeader and PageBody, `py-6` in PageBody), modal x-padding.

tokens.name: space-10

tokens.name: space-20

tokens.usage: Tooltips and toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-xl

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: `hover:shadow-glow` on the primary Button and IconButton: a 1px primary/40 ring plus a primary/45 bloom. Resolved here from each theme's primary.
